about: Recording R0.7 20261021-1212 'rack2' (iPhone 16 Pro Max, low side, home 7 ft, 9-ball, 373.8 s). It holds TWO complete racks: rack 2A (0-167 s) and rack 2B (re-racked 168-196 s, break 212.4 s). First ball was judged at 1-3 fps only; null = not judged. Not reviewed by the player. (rack2A)
